sources.note: Nothing: the words 'stress' and 'accent' do not occur in the 32-page article. Section 6 'Tone' (pp. 201-206) describes three level tones H, M, L with one tone per syllable in citation forms; Section 3 gives syllable/word structure (62% of nouns disyllabic, 35% monosyllabic); the Summary (pp. 205-206) says phenomena of longer stretches of speech and the prosodic organization of the language are not discussed.
